name: get_context
description: Get the current workbench state: genre, loudness target, each bus's chain, meter readings, flagged symptoms, favorite count, custom plugin count. Call this before advising so you know what the producer is actually looking at.

name: set_genre
description: Switch the active genre (changes which plugins are starred as top picks).

name: switch_tab
description: Navigate the workbench to a different tab so Kev physically sees what you're working on with him.

tab.description: The tab id to switch to.

name: cue_video
description: Cue a YouTube video or private Mix With The Masters lesson paused in the Library player. Keep Kev on his current tab by default; set switch_to_library true only when he asks to see or watch the video. When building a chain from a video, put the chain on the MixBus first, then cue the video without switching tabs and tell Kev it is ready when he wants it. A non-library YouTube transcript starts reading in the background; use read_video_transcript to answer questions without asking Kev to run through it. Library and mwtm- lessons use read_yt_knowledge.

video_id.description: An 11-character YouTube ID or an mwtm- lesson ID (KB slug-pNN or private Set-NN form).

title.description: Source title, especially for a video outside the ingested Library.

channel.description: Source channel, especially for a video outside the ingested Library.

switch_to_library.description: True only when Kev asks to see or watch the video; otherwise keep the current tab.

name: search_youtube_videos
description: Search YouTube for a video Kev asks to find or show. Returns up to five IDs, titles, channels and durations. If the first clearly matches, call cue_video and say what you cued; if unclear ask which result he wants.

name: read_video_transcript
description: Get relevant excerpts from a cued YouTube video outside the library. The transcript starts reading automatically when cued. If it is still loading, tell Kev 'give me a sec while I read the transcript', then answer from the returned excerpts. Do not ask whether to run through the transcript. This does not add the video.

query.description: Optional topic or question to find the most relevant transcript chunks.

name: add_video_to_library
description: Add a YouTube video to Hope’s transcript library. Kev’s clear instruction to add it is enough; ingestion reads the transcript. For your own unprompted offer, offer only after read_video_transcript and sharing the findings. First call with confirmed false for the summary; use confirmed true only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add it.

confirmed.description: True only after Kev clearly confirms adding this video.

name: open_library_channel
description: Open a YouTube channel in the Library Playlist and return up to 40 videos with titles, durations and library status. Pass Kev’s topic as query when he asks for channel recommendations.

channel.description: YouTube @handle, channel URL, or exact channel name.

query.description: Optional topic to filter the channel’s videos.

switch_to_library.description: Switch to the Library tab. Defaults to true when omitted.

name: show_library_picks
description: Show only the selected videos in the existing Library Playlist for Kev to preview. This does not add them.

video_ids.description: 1 to 15 YouTube video IDs in the order they should appear.

name: add_videos_to_library
description: Add up to 10 YouTube videos sequentially to the AIMM Library. Call with confirmed false first for the summary. Use confirmed true only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add the videos. Returns a result for each video.

video_ids.description: 1 to 10 YouTube video IDs to add to the AIMM Library.

confirmed.description: False for the summary. True only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add these videos.

name: set_platform
description: Change the loudness target / platform (master bus reference).

name: add_plugin_to_bus
description: Add a plugin to a bus. The plugin name MUST match something in Kev's library. Position is 1-indexed; omit to append at end.

plugin.description: Plugin name — must be one Kev owns.

name: remove_plugin_from_bus
description: Remove a plugin from a bus by its 1-indexed position.

name: move_plugin
description: Reorder a plugin within a bus. Positions are 1-indexed.

name: clear_bus
description: Remove all plugins from a bus.

name: toggle_symptom
description: Toggle a flagged mix symptom in the Troubleshooter. Use the symptom id from list_symptoms.

name: list_symptoms
description: List available symptom ids and their labels.

name: toggle_favorite
description: Heart / un-heart a plugin in the library (fuzzy name match).

name: record_meter
description: Record a meter reading. meter is one of: iLufs, tp, lra, corr, crest.

name: add_custom_plugin
description: Add a plugin to the library that isn't already built in. stage must be one of the known stage ids.

publisher.description: slate, ssl, ua, softube, sonnox, sonible, sndtoys, izotope, eiosis, weiss, oek, waves, ni, pa, ant, cele, liq, or other

publisher_label.description: If publisher is other, supply a label like FabFilter

name: remove_custom_plugin
description: Remove a CUSTOM plugin from Kev's library. Built-in plugins cannot be removed — only ones added via add_custom_plugin. Match by name (fuzzy match supported).

name.description: Plugin name. Fuzzy match — but only custom plugins are eligible.

name: list_plugins
description: Search the plugin library. Pass stage_id or search text.

name: get_library
description: Return the full current plugin library grouped by stage. Call this if Kev mentions he just added plugins or you want a fresh dump.

name: set_plugin_settings
description: Pin concrete setting notes to a specific plugin on a bus. USE THIS EVERY TIME you give specific parameter values — the notes persist in the UI so Kev doesn't have to scroll the transcript.

plugin.description: Plugin name — fuzzy match. Use this OR position.

position.description: 1-indexed position on the bus. Use this OR plugin.

settings.description: Terse, actionable notes. Prefer one parameter per line. Max ~6 lines.

name: clear_plugin_settings
description: Remove settings notes from a plugin on a bus.

name: inspect_app
description: Search the live AI Mix Masters source code (index.html) for a term — function name, button id, CSS class, label text, anything. USE THIS when Kev asks what a button actually does or how something works under the hood.

name: read_doc
description: Read one of Kev's project docs — CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, or DASHBOARD.html. USE THIS when Kev asks what's on the roadmap, what shipped recently, or what the handover says.

name: search_yt_knowledge
description: Search the FULL YouTube Knowledge Base (all ingested videos, hundreds and growing) for chunks relevant to a topic. This is the PRIMARY way to discover KB content — call it on ANY mixing, production, or plugin question before answering from general knowledge. Returns the top-scoring transcript chunks with their video_id/title/channel so you can cite properly. Once you have a promising video_id, call read_yt_knowledge(video_id, query) for more of that specific video. Brief Kev before calling: 'hold on, checking my notes…'. Cite the video title and channel when you draw from the result, call cue_video with its returned video_id, and tell Kev it is cued in the player.

query.description: The topic or question to search for, e.g. 'sidechain kick and bass', 'Logic Pro file organization', 'de-essing harsh vocals'.

n.description: Optional number of chunks to return (default 6, max 10).

name: read_yt_knowledge
description: Fetch the full transcript of an ingested YouTube video from the YOUTUBE KNOWLEDGE BASE. Call this AFTER search_yt_knowledge has identified a relevant video_id, to pull more of that specific video's transcript. Optionally pass a query to get back only the most relevant chunks (recommended — keeps output lean). Returns up to ~4KB of transcript content. Brief Kev before calling: 'hold on, checking my notes from that video…'. Cite the video title and channel when you draw from the result, call cue_video with its returned video_id, and tell Kev it is cued in the player.

video_id.description: The video_id — from a prior search_yt_knowledge result, or the YOUTUBE TOPIC INDEX fast-path list, e.g. '6WPtHxWkY2k'.

query.description: Optional keyword or phrase to find the most relevant chunks. E.g. 'quantise', 'drum pattern', 'recording audio'. If omitted, returns the first few chunks.

name: emit_notebooklm_prompt
description: Drop a NotebookLM prompt and sources into the Conversation transcript as one copyable bubble without reading the template aloud. Before calling, search_youtube_videos for the best few videos on the topic; prefer Mix With The Masters and strong tutorials. Pass 2-5 actual search results as sources (title and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID URL). Never invent links. If none are relevant or search fails, omit sources and tell Kev briefly. USE THIS whenever you offer a NotebookLM prompt and Kev says yes. After calling, speak only a brief intro and topic line, then remind Kev to paste the NotebookLM summary into Insight as a new KB note. DO NOT read the prompt body aloud.

topic.description: Short, specific topic from Kev's question — producer or technique name.

sources.description: Optional 2-5 real videos returned by search_youtube_videos. Omit when no relevant results are found; never invent links.

title.description: Video title from the search result.

url.description: YouTube watch URL built from the returned video_id.

name: capture_to_roadmap
description: Capture a concrete idea, bug, polish item, or feature request to Kev's project dashboard inbox. CRITICAL: NEVER say 'I will add it to the roadmap' without calling this tool — that is confabulation.

force.description: Set true only after Kev confirms he wants to log a near-duplicate.

name: list_eq_tiles
description: List the cards on the Reference tab, optionally filtered by section.

name: add_eq_tile
description: Add a custom reference tile to the Reference tab. Lead with your audio mastering knowledge — suggest the right section and propose a concrete title and body grounded in real ranges.

name: remove_eq_tile
description: Remove a custom Reference tile by title or id. Built-in tiles cannot be deleted.

name: list_knowledge_notes
description: List Knowledge Base notes — id, title, source, tags, ts, active flag.

active_only.description: If true, only notes currently injected into session context are returned.

name: add_knowledge_note
description: Add a research/technique note to Kev's Knowledge Base. Keep titles concise and content focused.

content.description: The note body. Plain text, can be multi-line.

activate.description: If true, the note becomes part of the voice session context immediately.

name: export_knowledge_note
description: Export a Knowledge Base note to disk or clipboard.

target.description: download = save a .md file. clipboard = copy text to system clipboard.

name: save_preset
description: Save the current chain as a named user preset. CRITICAL: if Kev has NOT said what to call the preset, ask him first — never invent a name. Only call this tool once you have an actual name from him.

name.description: The exact name Kev told you to use.

bus.description: Which bus to save. Default 'all' saves every non-empty bus.

name: mark_fix_applied
description: Mark the current full-mix Fix Queue item as applied after Kev clearly says yes and Hope has successfully called add_plugin_to_bus and set_plugin_settings for the agreed move. Never call on a no, a vague reply, an explanation-only request, or merely to skip an item. After marking, give a one-line confirmation and walk through the next item. Skip declined items with skip_fix after a final no.

fix_id.description: Optional fix id such as '#01'. Omit to mark the current active fix — the normal case.

name: open_dashboard
description: Opens the live AIMM project dashboard in a new browser tab. Use this when Kev wants to review the roadmap, check what's in flight, or scan the backlog together. Offer it naturally: 'Want me to pull up the dashboard so we can look at it together?' — then call it if he says yes.

name: web_search_fallback
description: Last resort. Call this ONLY after search_yt_knowledge and read_yt_knowledge have returned nothing usable for the question. Never call it first. Use it for live facts such as plugin manuals, release dates or chart data that the knowledge base does not hold.

name: skip_fix
description: On Kev’s final no, skip the current full-mix Fix Queue item and move on. Use restore:true when he later asks to do a skipped fix after all. An optional id targets a specific fix.

id.description: Optional Fix Queue id such as #01. Omit to skip the current fix or restore the most recently skipped fix.

restore.description: True to restore a skipped fix to waiting.

name: unmark_fix_applied
description: Reopen a marked-done full-mix Fix Queue item only when Kev asks to undo a fix. After removing the plug-in Hope added (or clearing its settings as appropriate), call this to untick the fix. Omit id to reopen the most recently marked-done fix. Never undo without Kev asking.

id.description: Optional Fix Queue id such as "#01". Omit to reopen the most recently marked-done fix.
